title: The 4 Best Adjustable Dumbbells for Beginners
h1: The 4 Best Adjustable Dumbbells for Beginners
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for adjustable dumbbells for beginners, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at adjustable dumbbells for beginners using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Core Home Fitness Adjustable Dumbbell Set & Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 50 lb per hand, TwistLock one-hand cradle adjustment, Contoured soft-grip handle.
strengths: TwistLock is one of the simplest mechanisms to learn, no marks or numbers to line up
50 lb ceiling comfortably covers a beginner's first one to two years
Lower price than Bowflex or PowerBlock for a first serious purchase
limitations: Only works correctly with the dumbbell seated in its stand
Fewer accessories than Bowflex's broader ecosystem

products.name: Amazon Basics Adjustable Dumbbell Hand Weight Set, 38 lb with Case
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 lb total across two handles, Spin-lock collars, Portable storage case.
strengths: Cheapest way to find out if home strength training sticks before a bigger purchase
No mechanism to learn beyond hand-tightening a collar
Case makes it easy to store away between sessions
limitations: Slowest adjustment method, less ideal once you're cycling through multiple weights per session
19 lb max per hand is light once basic strength develops

products.name: Bowflex SelectTech 552 Adjustable Dumbbells (Pair)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 52.5 lb per hand, 2.5 lb increments, Dial-turn selector, Molded storage trays included.
strengths: Highest ceiling in this list, room to grow well past a beginner's first year without upgrading
Widest parts and community support if you have questions starting out
Fine 2.5 lb increments make it easy to find a comfortable starting weight
limitations: Costs significantly more than the budget picks in this list
More dumbbell than most true beginners need on day one
features: 5 to 52.5 lb per hand, 2.5 lb increments

products.name: NordicTrack 55 lb Select-a-Weight Dumbbell
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 55 lb per hand, 2.5, 5, and 10 lb increments, iFIT connected workout compatibility.
strengths: iFIT's guided strength programming is genuinely useful for beginners unsure how to structure a workout
Fine low-end increments help beginners find the right starting weight
Dial mechanism is fast and familiar once learned
limitations: Full iFIT programming requires a paid subscription beyond any trial period
More expensive than Core Home Fitness for a comparable core mechanism

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
